agent.report:
I changed nothing, so there was nothing to commit. The tree is clean at `38cc90c` on `main`.

Unclear points, and how I read them:
- "Everything the window decides" I took to mean the review window only. The claim window (`CLAIM_WINDOW_DAYS` in `Support/Domain/Claim/ClaimRules.ts`) is a separate constant, so I left it out. ADR 74 calls it "the same window as a review's", but only in prose.
- Docs and contracts also say "14 days" (ADR 59, ADR 62, ADR 74, `conventions/domain.yaml`, `conventions/storms/reviews.yaml`). I left them out of the list because they are not source files.
- I ran the Reviews unit specs on a scratch copy with the constant set to 30. Six tests fail across three files, as listed below. The two review e2e files and the ratings e2e file need Postgres, which I did not run, so their entries come from reading the code.

```yaml
rules:
  - Review window: a stay is reviewed from the day after check-out up to N days after it; later or earlier writes are refused with OutsideReviewWindow (REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS, isInReviewWindow; used by reviewByTraveller and reviewByGuest)
  - Publication of a stay's two reviews: published when both are written or the window has closed (isPublished, windowClosed; ADR 60)
  - Host reply to a traveller's review only once published, otherwise ReviewNotPublished (replyToTravellerReview)
  - Report of a review: an unpublished review is a not-found to anyone but its author (reportReview)
  - Ratings count only published traveller reviews (ratingOf, publishedTravellerReviews, ratingsOfListings; used by GetHostRating and the Listings and Booking rating adapters)
  - Read visibility of reviews on listing, booking and guest-review queries (publishedOn; GetListingReviews, GetBookingReviews, GetGuestReviews)
files:
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/ReviewWindow.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewExceptions.ts
tests:
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviews.spec.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewReports.spec.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/Rating.spec.ts
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/reviews.e2e.spec.ts
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/ratings.e2e.spec.ts
```
